patient.name: Kamala Subramanian
patient.note: Lives with son and daughter-in-law in Chennai. Speaks Tamil and English. Vegetarian diet, low salt. Uses a walker. Sample patient, all data is fictional.

entries.text: Mild swelling in both ankles by evening. Legs raised for 30 minutes.
Slept well. Good appetite, ate 2 idli with sambar.
Complained of dizziness on standing up. BP checked and noted; advised to rise slowly.
Pain in right knee after physiotherapy, 4 out of 10. Applied warm compress.
Reduced appetite since morning, only had tea and a few biscuits.
Cheerful today, walked to the balcony with walker support.
Small redness near the dressing site on left hip. Cleaned and re-dressed.
Fever with chills since last night. Body ache. Fluids encouraged.
Fever persists, appetite poor. Gave paracetamol; called Dr. Raman by phone.
Fever settled. Feeling weak but eating khichdi.
Constipation for two days. Increased water and papaya at lunch.
Slept late due to leg cramps. Massaged calves.
